valuationInputs.name: Beta
valuationInputs.reason: 8 steps, 15 Nov 2026. (1) Business: a Sri Lankan group with four operating segments (agri solutions: fertiliser, crop protection, seeds; livestock solutions: feed and poultry; industrial solutions: paints and chemicals; health and personal care) plus an equity-accounted stake of about 6% in John Keells. The record has no segment profit split, so the four segments are weighted equally; the John Keells stake (about 21% of H1 FY2027 profit, Rs 0.67bn of Rs 3.17bn) is a diversified group itself and is assumed to have the same beta. (2) Damodaran's emerging-markets dataset (betaEmerg) could NOT be opened: his site is blocked by this run's network settings. Stand-ins from web-search extracts of his global sector table, unlevered and cash-corrected: Farming/Agriculture 0.49 (date not shown), Food Processing 0.56 (January 2026), Chemical (Diversified) 0.91 (date not shown), Drugs (Pharmaceutical) 1.00 (as used for HHL, date not shown). Average (0.49 + 0.56 + 0.91 + 1.00) ÷ 4 = 0.74. (3) Relevered with debt to market value 0.66 and the standard 30% tax: 0.74 × (1 + 0.7 × 0.66) = 1.08. The debt is GROSS borrowings Rs 35.0bn (30 Sep 2026) because cash isn't in the record, against market value Rs 52.9bn (1,458.0mn voting × Rs 28.80 + 437.4mn non-voting × Rs 25.00, CSE close 13 Nov 2026); net debt would give a somewhat lower beta. (4) Local 5-year betas: none found. Simply Wall St 0.19 (no period stated) and TradingView 1.32 (1-year, ignored); stockanalysis.com couldn't be opened. Fewer than 3 usable sources. (5) Higher of 1.08 and (no local figure) = 1.08. (6) Within 0.3–2. (7) Into the formula by scripts/reinvestment.py. Provisional: refresh in January 2027 with Damodaran's emerging-markets file, segment profit weights and cash (a /redo CIC full would record them).

valuationInputs.reason: From scripts/reinvestment.py (15 Nov 2026): 8.24% + 1.08 × (4.2% + 6.08%) = 19.3%, ±1.5 points. Replaces the hand-set 20 / 18 / 16.5%.

changeLog.basedOn: H1 FY2027 (to Sep 2026); research record only
changeLog.summary: Requested from Telegram (/redo CIC.X0000; queued for CIC.N0000, which covers both share classes). Redone from the saved record with the current brief. Beta 1.08 (provisional: Damodaran's site was blocked, so global sector betas for agriculture, food processing, chemicals and pharma from web-search extracts, averaged equally because no segment split is recorded, relevered with gross borrowings because cash isn't recorded; no local 5-year beta found) gives cost of equity 19.3% (was 18% by hand). P/E method now a justified P/E (3.9 / 4.5 / 5.4x) instead of 6 / 8 / 10x: weighted 32.3 → 18.5. P/B 19.0 → 17.2; residual income 16.6 → 14.1. Added a trailing-12-month EPS period (Rs 3.94, worked out from recorded figures). Growth check within 2 pts (9.6 / 12.6 / 14.5% vs 12.9% supported). WACC, DCF and the capex-based checks not possible: capex, depreciation, cash and interest paid aren't in the record. Business tests 3 of 4, unchanged; category unchanged (watch list). Fair value Rs 22.60 → 16.60, buy Rs 19.20 → 14.10, strong buy Rs 17.00 → 12.50.
